returns 1 when the fifth argument `n` is null; finds the first index `i` below dword `[rdx+0x20]` AND 0x7FFFFFFF whose name (qword `i` of qword `[rdx+0x28]` with bit `0x1` cleared) is `n` or a byte-equal string, returning 0x13 when none; with `p` = the sixth argument or 1 when that is below 2, it pops entry `e` from the free list at qword `[rcx+8]` (refilled once by `00680150(rcx+8, dword [rcx+0x24])`; still empty returns 0xD); `h` = `006856E0(rcx, p)`, and the words at `rcx+0xF8` + 2*k for k = `h`, `h`+`p`, ... below 0x100 are incremented; it stores word `e+0x26` = `h`, qword `e+0x30` = the seventh argument, qwords `e+8`/`+0x10`/`+0x18` = `rdx`/`r8`/`r9`, dword `e+0x20` = `i`, word `e+0x24` = `p`, dword `e+0x28` = 0, links `e` at the head of qword `[rcx+0x40]`; returns 0

method: The page declares the family `Phyre PScripting module` (a classification family: ordinary functions grouped by module, not template copies). No page explained these members. A local drafting agent (local-ee-drafter) drafted one sentence and 1-5 interior anchors per body from OPUS's pack (`mem_pack.py`); OPUS checked every row mechanically with `interior_ingest.py` (member mode: the body is an unexplained member of a family this page declares). A second local agent, not the drafter, then read every one of the 272 rows of this batch against the disassembly (repetitive destructors, initialisers and clone bodies compared instruction by instruction against a fixed template): 262 stood, 10 clauses in 8 functions were corrected (signed compares written as above/below, one missing dereference, two operand groupings, one pair of per-pair callees). OPUS confirmed each correction at the bytes and re-read a random sample of the rows that stood; the corrections are listed below. Neither agent is an independent reviewer: the non-author check is SWE2-AUDIT-SPEC's.
